required.desc: src/pagination.ts:7 off-by-one — `for (let i = 0; i <= pageCount; i++)` should be `i < pageCount`; the current loop emits one trailing empty page past the real data

src/cart.ts:14 swapped argument order — `applyDiscount(item.priceCents, item.discountPct)` calls pricing.ts's `applyDiscount(pct, priceCents)` with the arguments reversed, so a $40.00 item at 15% off is priced as if $40 were the discount percentage
src/cart.ts:33 missing await — `const taxRate = fetchTaxRate(region);` binds a Promise<number>, not a number; the promise object is then used directly in `1 + taxRate` arithmetic on the next line

src/report.ts:19 null-deref behind an incomplete guard — `if (order.customer)` does not guarantee `order.customer.address` is set (it's an optional field per the `Customer` type), so `order.customer.address.city` throws for any customer without a saved address
